title: CDA Takes Control of Five Commercial Plazas in Islamabad
excerpt: The Capital Development Authority and local administration have taken possession of five commercial plazas in Islamabad.
body_html:
The Capital Development Authority (CDA), alongside the Islamabad Capital Territory (ICT) Administration, has officially taken control of five commercial plazas located in Mouza.

Authorities executed the takeover as part of their ongoing administrative actions in the area. Further details regarding the specific reasons for the possession or the exact location within Mouza were not immediately disclosed in the initial reports.
